Their work also includes methods for producing lithium-rich compositions and cathode active materials, supporting battery recycling and sustainable material production.

overview_description.description: Redwood Materials creates a circular supply chain to drive down the environmental footprint and cost of lithium-ion batteries and the electric vehicles and sustainable energy storage systems they power. It offers recycling of end-of-life batteries and production scrap, refining of critical elements, and deployment of large-scale energy-storage systems using second-life battery packs.

identifier.value: Redwood Energy Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

product.name: Redwood Energy Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
product.description: Large-scale battery storage systems designed, integrated, and deployed for data centers, utilities, renewable projects, industrial facilities, and grid applications using new and repurposed batteries.

product.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling
product.description: Collection, processing, and recycling of end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, battery packs, and consumer devices to recover reusable critical materials.

product.name: Battery-Grade Critical Materials
product.description: Refined lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper recovered from used batteries and production scrap for use in domestic battery manufacturing and other industrial applications.

product.name: Cathode Active Material
product.description: Battery cathode active material manufactured from refined and recycled feedstocks for use in lithium-ion battery cell production.

product.name: Anode Copper Foil
product.description: Copper foil for lithium-ion battery anodes, manufactured as a domestic battery component using Redwood’s integrated materials-production capabilities.

identifier.value: EV Battery Pack Buying and Collection Service

product.name: EV Battery Pack Buying and Collection Service
product.description: A service for auto recyclers and dismantlers to identify, price, sell, and arrange pickup of electric-vehicle and hybrid battery packs through Redwood’s online portal.
